versions.subject: [OSCD] Powershell Script Installed as a Service Rule added
versions.detection:
selection:
  EventID: 1
  ParentImage|endswith: '\services.exe'
  CommandLine|contains: 
    - 'powershell'
    - 'pwsh'
selection2:
  EventID:
    - 7045
    - 4697
  ServiceFileName|contains: 
    - 'powershell'
    - 'pwsh'
selection3:
  EventID: 13
  TargetObject: '*\Services\*\ImagePath'
  Details|contains:
    - 'powershell'
    - 'pwsh'
condition: selection or selection2 or selection3
versions.spl: (EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\services.exe" CommandLine IN ("*powershell*", "*pwsh*")) OR (EventID IN (7045, 4697) ServiceFileName IN ("*powershell*", "*pwsh*")) OR (EventID=13 TargetObject="*\\Services\*\\ImagePath" Details IN ("*powershell*", "*pwsh*"))
